name: Indian Institute of Skills & Languages
description: IISL Delhi is both a skills and language training institute for learners and a digital agency for businesses, based in Rohini. It offers practical computer, digital marketing, web development, and language courses, as well as website development, SEO, digital advertising, e-commerce, and social media services.
